reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "L7 network policy with terminatingTLS will not load the key `ca.crt` even if it is present in the secret", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: L7 network policies with terminatingTLS will no longer load ca.crt from secrets by default, preventing Envoy from incorrectly requiring client certificates; environments relying on the old behavior must set --use-full-tls-context=true.
consequence.remediation: If the old behavior is required for compatibility, set --use-full-tls-context=true when running cilium

proposed.statement: L7 network policy with terminatingTLS no longer loads the ca.crt key from secrets by default; set --use-full-tls-context=true to restore the old behavior.
